## Context / Problem
The tests/scripts/reducer cohort contains 167 syntactic prose/directive blocks across the 16 recorded file-impact paths: 165 editable prose blocks and two protected directive-only blocks. Condense repetition, obvious narration, and obsolete RED/TDD history while retaining the implemented reducer contracts.

The prose inventory and immutable before-citations are pinned to origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e. At plan repair time origin/main had advanced to 10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396 only through unrelated workflow/grounding files; none of this ticket's scoped blobs changed. Implement from current origin/main, but keep 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e as the immutable prose-audit basis. The final leaf change is one commit, so changed-path checks use HEAD^..HEAD rather than the audit-base aggregate.

## Approach
Edit only ordinary comments and docstrings at the stable anchors below. Correct obsolete claims that cache, inbound, edit, LLM-format, or marker behavior is unimplemented. Use current rebar.reducer naming where factual. Preserve current contracts rather than historical "RED before fix" narratives. Do not edit executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, or unlisted prose.

For every Python path, parse base and final source with ast.parse(source, type_comments=True). Recursively remove only the leading Expr(Constant(str)) from bodies of Module, ClassDef, FunctionDef, and AsyncFunctionDef; normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno; then require exact ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False) equality. Separately preserve directive text and attachment because comments are absent from the AST.

A non-author reviewer must post exactly 165 leaf-linked TSV rows, one per edited prose block:
path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session
Before and after citations use full immutable commit SHAs. Both verdict columns must be PASS; missing rows block closure. Because this is a 16-file, approximately 6,150-LOC review, the row count may not be sampled.

## Scope — 165 editable blocks
- test_managed_refs.py — module docstring and four named test docstrings.
- test_reducer_cache.py — module docstring, Test 12 through Test 17b banners, and their seven test docstrings. Describe caching as implemented.
- test_reducer_core.py — module docstring; Test 1 through Test 11 and "Corrupt-event skip behavior" banners; the inline "Directory exists…" comment; and all scoped named test docstrings.
- test_reducer_exclude_session_logs.py — module docstring.
- test_reducer_fields.py — module docstring, all seven named test banners, and five scoped test docstrings.
- test_reducer_file_impact.py — module docstring, FILE_IMPACT banner, and six test docstrings; exclude the adjacent E402 directives from editing.
- test_reducer_links.py — module docstring; LINK/UNLINK, same-second ordering, and alias-normalization banners; and four test docstrings/comment oracles.
- test_reducer_reduce_all.py — module docstring; archived/hash/orphan banners; and eight test docstrings.
- test_reducer_snapshot.py — module docstring; Test 18 through Test 23 banners; and six corresponding test docstrings.
- test_ticket_alias_backfill.py — module docstring, three module comment groups, and two snapshot-only resolver docstrings.
- test_ticket_inbound.py — module docstring plus "Fixtures/helpers" and "Tests" banners. Describe inbound support as implemented.
- test_ticket_llm_format.py — module docstring and seven module section banners.
- test_ticket_reducer_conflict.py — module docstring, _write_event docstring, four test banners, and three scoped test docstrings.
- test_ticket_reducer_edit.py — module docstring plus eight section/test banners. Describe edit support as implemented.
- test_ticket_reducer_llm_format.py — module docstring, four test banners, and four test docstrings. Describe LLM formatting as implemented.
- test_ticket_reducer_marker.py — module docstring; import, fixture, and Test 0 through Test 6 banners; fixture docstring; and seven test docstrings. Describe marker support as implemented.

## Consumers and protected directives
Pytest executes all 16 modules; their local fixtures/helpers support those tests. scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py is the deterministic prose-policy consumer. No targeted __doc__, inspect.getdoc, or doctest consumer was found.

Preserve the following exact text attached to the same executable statements:
- test_managed_refs.py: # type: ignore[union-attr]
- test_reducer_core.py: # noqa: BLE001
- test_reducer_core.py: # noqa: PT017
- test_reducer_file_impact.py: both # noqa: E402 directives
- test_reducer_reduce_all.py: # noqa: E402
- test_ticket_inbound.py: # pragma: no cover - RED guard
- test_ticket_llm_format.py: # noqa: E402
- test_ticket_reducer_marker.py: both # noqa: BLE001 directives
- test_ticket_reducer_marker.py: # type: ignore[type-arg]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the 165 allowlisted prose blocks or adjacent blank lines change; protected directive-only blocks do not.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter, current, and free of obsolete unimplemented/RED claims.
- [ ] Normalized Python ASTs are exactly equal between 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e and the final commit.
- [ ] Every protected directive retains exact text and attachment; runtime strings remain AST-identical.
- [ ] Sorted paths changed by the single leaf commit HEAD^..HEAD exactly equal the 16 recorded file-impact paths.
- [ ] The non-author TSV contains exactly 165 passing rows with full before/final SHAs.
- [ ] The semantic, directive, path-set, diff, hygiene, focused-test, and full-repository commands recorded under Verification pass.

## Verification
Run every structured verify command. The AST and directive comparators are the executable semantic guards; the independent 165-row TSV is authoritative for prose quality.
